title: Hold a licence to keep dangerous substances
what: Store or handle dangerous goods above the manifest quantities only at a site licensed by the Chief Officer (the Dangerous Goods Safety Act 2004 s 13 makes an unlicensed site an offence), unless an exemption in reg 25 applies.
